thread:
maya-cs: Heads-up — customer reported free-trial credits not visible in their main org after SSO/merge. Account: org_acme_pay (org_0x3a9). They say credits show on a duplicate workspace org_acme_pay_old (org_0x3a9_legacy). Can billing confirm where the promo grant landed?

maya-cs: Quick context: customer signed up, got promo code AUTO-TRIAL-40, later did SSO migration which created a legacy workspace. They were billed (token usage) against the new org, but UI shows 0 trial credits on the new org. They provided workspace IDs and screenshots.

tom-billing: on it. Can you paste the org IDs and promo code? I can check allocations table.

maya-cs: Org ids: new org org_0x3a9, legacy org org_0x3a9_legacy. Promo: AUTO-TRIAL-40. Customer email: sara@acme.example.

tom-billing: running quick query now:
```sql
SELECT org_id, credit_amount, allocated_by, created_at
FROM credits_allocations
WHERE promo_code = 'AUTO-TRIAL-40'
  AND org_id IN ('org_0x3a9','org_0x3a9_legacy');
```

credits-bot: query result (cached): 1 row — org_id=org_0x3a9_legacy, credit_amount=4000, allocated_by=promo-service, created_at=2025-11-05T13:02:11Z

tom-billing: ok confirms credits are allocated to legacy org. Looks like allocation happened before SSO merge and didn't reassign. We can transfer credits manually but need engineering signoff for idempotency and audit log.

kevin-eng: Thanks for ping. This is likely the same edge-case in the org-merge flow — our ssosync handler creates a new workspace and we currently don't reconcile promo allocations. I can review the merge audit trail. Can you attach the user_id and merge event id?

maya-cs: merge_event_id: me_20251105_77f, primary_user_id: usr_0x9a2 (sara). I uploaded the screenshot of the merge success from the console and the billing link to the promo code.

lina-sre: FYI I checked logs for the merge window 2025-11-05 12:48-13:10 UTC — see repeated webhook from identity provider then a follow-up account create. We're seeing two org rows in pg:
```text
org table rows:
- id: org_0x3a9, created_at: 2025-11-05T12:49:02Z, status: active
- id: org_0x3a9_legacy, created_at: 2025-10-30T09:11:40Z, status: inactive
```
The credits_allocations row points to the legacy org as tom-billing shared.

kevin-eng: I think safe manual remediation: billing can run transfer script to move credits row -> new org_id, and we add an audit entry. I'll open a quick PR to add a guard in the ssosync flow so future allocations are reconciled.

tom-billing: I'll do the transfer after we confirm the amount and get eng on the audit record. Proposed steps:
1) create audit entry in credits_audit (manual_op = 'transfer_for_merged_org', refs: me_20251105_77f)
2) update credits_allocations set org_id='org_0x3a9', updated_by='billing_manual', updated_at=now() where id=<row id>
3) notify customer and close ticket

maya-cs: Customer is available for a 15-min window. They want the credits restored today.

kevin-eng: I'm good with the manual transfer as long as billing creates the audit record and we tag the merge_event_id. I'll also schedule a follow-up to fix the ssosync idempotency.

tom-billing: Executing now — creating audit entry then updating allocation.

credits-bot: AUDIT CREATED: id=aud_0x7f2, actor=tom-billing, op=transfer_for_merged_org, refs=[me_20251105_77f], ts=2025-11-05T14:02:05Z

credits-bot: ALLOCATION UPDATED: allocation_id=alloc_0x5a1, old_org=org_0x3a9_legacy, new_org=org_0x3a9, amount=4000, performed_by=tom-billing, ts=2025-11-05T14:02:09Z

tom-billing: Verified balances: new org now shows 4000 trial credits. I also added metadata: reason='manual transfer after SSO merge'.

maya-cs: I notified the customer and they confirmed they see the credits in the correct workspace. They appreciate the quick turnaround.

kevin-eng: Filed follow-up ticket ENG-ssosync-439 to reconcile credits on merge and added a unit test case for the allocation reconciliation. I'll pick this up in next sprint.

lina-sre: Leaving postmortem note: root cause = ssosync created new active org without backfilling allocation mapping; promo-service allocates to the existing org id at time of grant and we lacked a reconcile hook.

maya-cs: Closing the CS ticket. I put the conversation link in the ticket notes. Marking resolved :white_check_mark: Thanks team!
